Vote early.
 By Denise Yancey Published: October 26, 2026 Are you happy with your life today? Are you making enough money to pay all your bills with money left over? Have your relatives, friends, village or church done well financially, socially and spiritually over the last two years? If so, I’m happy for you. If not, and you want and need change, you have the power to do something about it. Nov. 3, 2026, is Election Day. But what if there is a blizzard and you can’t get to the polls that day?
 Solution: Vote early , Alaska!
 Whether you vote now or later, I suggest you research and make a list of all the ballot measures and candidates running for office in your area that may have been causing your money problems these last two years. Take the list into the booth with you.
 In Anchorage, bring your voting card, driver’s license or other form of legal identification to the Midtown Mall or City Hall, get in line, get verified and vote. Booths are open Monday through Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.; Saturday from 10 a.m. to 4 p.m. (Midtown) or noon to 3 p.m. (City Hall); and Sunday from noon to 4 p.m. (Midtown only).
 You have absolute privacy in the voting booth. No one can force you to vote a certain way. This is your chance for your voice to be heard!
 — Denise Yancey , Anchorage
